payload.objective: Finish required semantic consistency and independent-oracle boundaries in the same developer attempt.
instructions: Two concrete Manager static-review concerns to address before handoff: a Tester report currently can claim status passed while its checks include failed, and acceptance then trusts the passed label. Reject contradictory passing technical reports and acceptance of a candidate with supplied failed mandatory verification. Add adversarial tests; the deliberate fresh demo failure must still cause rework. Worker bounded developer-stage status need not pretend the whole task is accepted.

Enforce the approved policy that Tester cannot approve its own oracle: require a Manager-supplied oracle/test-strategy artifact for Tester assignments and bind the report to that assigned strategy where context is supplied. A simple immutable strategy JSON artifact from accepted plan is enough; do not create a new authority service. Reject Tester self-approval/changed strategy mutations and document structural/non-authentication limits.

Preserve evidence identity checks for nested references too: technical checks[].evidence_ref and Planner results[].evidence_refs must not reuse an artifact_id for different path/hash while only top-level refs are checked. Also require failed_acceptance_ids to be valid assigned/original criteria for rework. Add focused negative controls rather than a large framework.

These are static developer review findings, not independent executed failures; no fabricated result history. Keep all original acceptance and current candidate input/output clarification. Finish existing integration/tests and stop for separate Tester; do not expand scope or repeat already passing checks unnecessarily.
